# ZoneMap

> Plan and organize across multiple timezones. ZoneMap is a free world clock pro and timezone converter featuring real-time city clocks, an interactive day/night map, and instant timezone conversion.

ZoneMap (https://zonemap.live) is a free web application for visualizing and converting time across multiple timezones simultaneously. It is a world clock pro alternative designed for remote teams, travelers, and anyone working across international time zones.

## Features

- Real-time world clock showing current time in 70+ cities simultaneously
- Interactive world map with live day/night terminator (solar terminator) visualization
- Drag the map left or right to simulate any time of day and see the day/night boundary shift
- Timeline scrubber for planning meetings and events across timezones
- Working hours overlap bar — see at a glance when business hours overlap between cities
- Accurate IANA timezone data with automatic DST handling
- URL sharing — bookmark and share any city selection and time configuration
- Light and dark theme

## Use Cases

- Remote team scheduling: find overlapping working hours between cities like San Francisco, London, and Singapore
- International meeting planning: convert a meeting time across multiple timezones instantly
- Travel planning: check what time it is at your destination
- World clock replacement: a better-looking, map-integrated alternative to worldclock.com or worldtimebuddy.com
- Comparing city times side-by-side without switching between tabs

## Keywords

## Technical Details

- URL: https://zonemap.live
- Type: Free web application (SPA)
- Category: Productivity / Utilities / World Clock
- Pricing: Free, no account required
- Platform: Web — works in all modern browsers on desktop and mobile
- Technology: React, D3-geo, IANA timezone database

## Comparison

ZoneMap differs from alternatives in that it combines a live world map with a day/night overlay, making it immediately visual which cities are in daytime or nighttime. Unlike worldtimeserver.com or timeanddate.com, ZoneMap has no ads and is focused entirely on the core use case of comparing multiple city times at once.
